### A Helpless People
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/a-helpless-people
Passage: 1 Samuel 13:16-23
Points:
- Saul's impetuous disobedience left Israel without divine battle direction, forcing his troops into retreat.
- The Philistines suppressed Israel by removing their blacksmiths and charging high fees even to sharpen farm tools.
- Without weapons, Israel was reduced to total vulnerability and dependence on their oppressors.
- God allowed this desperate plight to remind Israel of the futility of trusting a human king over the Lord.
- Believers must examine their own hearts to ensure their reliance rests solely in God rather than worldly strength.

### Has the Church Been Disarmed by the World?
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/has-the-church-been-disarmed-by-the-world
Passage: 1 Samuel 13:19-23
Points:
- Israel became comfortable depending on Philistine metalworkers in peacetime, leaving them unarmed when war arrived.
- This historical situation mirrors how modern believers can unwittingly rely on secular culture for essential needs.
- Relying on the world for education, news interpretation, and entertainment dulls the believer's spiritual edge.
- Christians must recognize they are engaged in spiritual warfare and ensure their minds are armed by God's truth.
